cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.

mechanism: A directs a camp recovery while treating the loose peg and earlier coat warning as deliberately planted cues for the failure.
confusable: D229 blames harmless detail while hiding own role; D233 claims the failure itself was planned narrative development.
comparison: Wet campers and recovery equipment differ from video editing.
seedUse: Prepare both early details before the final coat use, and make A's expertise direct actual recovery.
